applicant.name: Dr. Maria Zangerl
applicant.organisation: Federal Ministry of Health, Department of Chronic Diseases (ministry)

purpose: For the national chronic kidney disease strategy, the ministry needs to know how many older patients with chronic kidney disease receive no ACE inhibitor, by age band.
question: Among patients with chronic kidney disease aged 65 and over, how many have no active ACE inhibitor, by age band?
definitions: Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
ACE inhibitor = ATC code starting with C09AA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per band: patients with chronic kidney disease, how many of them have no active ACE inhibitor and that share in %, one decimal.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). A health data request is answered only with anonymised statistics; the applicant never sees the data (Art. 69).

judge.why: Rule 3: requested_as is a health data request from a ministry, which may claim a policy-making purpose.
